item.stem:
Nalini measures the heights of three plants as $12$ cm, $18$ cm, and $9$ cm. The figure shows a display she is planning.

Which claim about orientation fits the kind of measurement?

options.A: Call the finished picture a vertical column label only, without matching display direction to how heights are compared.
options.B: Say that choosing upward columns is what creates the three plant heights $12$, $18$, and $9$ cm.
options.C: Use upward columns so taller plants read as taller bars, matching how height is naturally compared.
options.D: Pick the largest printed number $18$ alone and treat that single number as the finished display.
